entries.Velon has fallen. He counseled weakness,: Velon has fallen. He counselled weakness, but did not deserve such an ugly death. We shall return with swords to avenge him!
entries.For days, Kalenz and his small host of f: For days, Kalenz and his small host of followers travelled, moving nearer and yet nearer to the Ka’lian. Thanks to the dense fog and elvish woodscraft, the band was able to evade the orcish hunters. Then, as they were almost arrived at their destination, the north wind blew, and the fog lifted to reveal a grim sight...
entries.We must free them and make these saurian: We must free them and make these saurians pay. Attack and leave no-one alive!
entries.We are free! My lord Kalenz, from this d: We are free! My lord Kalenz, from this day forwards I and my kin are your sworn followers. And there is that which you should know about the treasure the orcs seek...
entries.Try to save leveled dwarf units: Try to save higher-level dwarf units
entries.Where there’s a contract, our honor is i: Where there’s a contract, our honour is involved. We will be there to cover your northern flank or else I will return your gold!
entries.I, too, believe him. Dwarves may be... r: I, too, believe him. Dwarves may be... rough... by our standards, but they are not liars. I think he knows that if he does not honour his contract, next time we will not be there to come to his aid.
entries.Our answer is still no. Prepare our defe: Our answer is still no. Prepare our defences as best you can, but do not renew offensive war. This is the Council’s decision.
entries.I think the orcs will be in no position: I think the orcs will be in no position to attack us for some time. Maybe we should go and see this mage. Olurf, can you take us there?
entries.It’s the source of your troubles. It is: It’s the source of your troubles. It is a very powerful magical artefact. The tyrant Haldric has it, but he has fooled the orcs into believing that the elves are hiding it. But now, they suspect they have been fooled. Haldric and his people will pay for his arrogance.
entries.Oh, no, I forgot my dose of Crelanu’s in: Oh, no, I forgot my dose of Crelanu’s invisibility philtre. I’ll go back and get it. I’ll catch up with you later!
Yes, I have the philtre of invisibility.
entries.Go tell the council and the human king t: Go and tell the council and the human king that we will be there! Now, let’s hurry!
entries.Enemy units cannot see this unit, except: Enemy units cannot see this unit, except for wolf-based units who can smell it if close enough. Hence except for wolf-based units, enemy units will not initiate an attack on this unit. Defence is at 80 per cent for every terrain except water, where it is 70 per cent.
entries.We need to kill the Great Chief and get: We need to kill the Great Chief and get out before the effect of the philtre ends. Time to drink it down now!
entries.This feels passing strange! Landar, reme: This feels passing strange! Landar, remember to stay far from the wolves — they may be able to smell us.
entries.Our defenses are stretched thin. Men, pr: Our defences are stretched thin. Men, prepare to face another orcish attack!
entries.Free of the pressure of war, they took d: Free of the pressure of war, they took delight in each other. The heart-bond they had formed amidst peril and death grew closer, and all but vanquished the remnant evil Crelanu’s philtre had left in Kalenz. The two began to think of having children.
entries.We have yet to break their defenses! Whi: We have yet to break their defences! While we are getting weaker, the enemy is getting stronger! Retreat!
entries.It is said that the battle with the Nort: It is said that the battle with the North Elves was the beginning of the end for Landar’s revolt. But civil war smouldered on for many more years, neither side mustering enough strength to achieve a decisive victory. Until, eventually, Landar’s increasingly harsh and arrogant ways drove away many of his followers. After assembling all the troops he could, Kalenz marched against his old friend and now mortal enemy, Landar, in the forest of Gitamoth...
entries.Kalenz buried Landar with full honors an: Kalenz buried Landar with full honours and made him a monument worthy of a true elvish hero.
entries.Cleodil bore Kalenz children who were ta: Cleodil bore Kalenz children who were tall, and beautiful, and inherited in full measure both their mother’s healing gifts and their father’s talented and searching mind. In the fullness of time, after a long life full of accomplishment and love and laughter, Cleodil died after the manner of elves, ageing swiftly to a peaceful end.
entries.But Kalenz’s story was not yet over. Aqu: But Kalenz’s story was not yet over. Aquagar’s curse was fulfilled; prolonged in life by Crelanu’s philtre, he outlived not only his beloved but their children. Sundered from his kin by their mortality, fleeing the reflections in their eyes of his lost beloved, he left his home and wandered for many a year across the Great Continent. Oft did he arrive unexpected at times and places when his people were in dire straits, and succour them with wisdom or magic or his bright keen blade.
